newsitem.title: USA: Lawmakers seek permanent US offshore drilling bans.
newsitem.headline: Lawmakers seek permanent US offshore drilling bans.

text.p: More than 100 lawmakers urged President Clinton on Wednesday to ban oil and gas drilling permanently off the eastern and western U.S. coasts and in the eastern Gulf of Mexico.

In a letter dated September 25, the bipartisan group of 110 House members asked Clinton to issue an executive order that would permanently extend existing drilling moratoria which Congress has reinstated year-to-year.
"We urge you to assist us in implementing longer term protection for these sensitive coastal waters," the representatives said.
"We believe that such permanent protection is necessary to protect the economies and the environment of our coastal communities," said the letter, delivered as Congressional campaign races heated up.
The letter was spearheaded by Reps. Lynn Woolsey, a California Democrat, Wayne Gilchrest, a Maryland Republican, and two congressmen from Florida, Democrat Peter Deutsch and Republican Porter Goss.
